ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across the mid-lobe regions, approximately 70% coverage, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) margins and a central dark region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs cover the central portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous perimeter along the trailing edge and distal tips, with a dense dark concentration at the median notch and lower peduncle area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex angle approximately 60 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced jagged valleys and peaks compared to the right lobe, which shows a relatively smoother, finer serration pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve originating from the median notch and tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast dark circular spots (mottling) scattered across the white fields of both lobes. Dense, irregular dark masses (barnacle clusters) are visible at both lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) extends vertically/diagonally through the mid-section of the left lobe. Several smaller, fainter vertical linear marks are visible near the base of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe. Visible biofouling (barnacle clusters) at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive large dark vertical streak on the left lobe and small circular dark spot on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.
